app.name: EAS CLI
app.one_liner: Fastest way to build, submit, and update iOS and Android apps using Expo's cloud infrastructure.

screens.name: Command Palette
screens.purpose: Primary interface for executing EAS CLI commands such as build, branch operations, and account management.

rust_commands.name: eas_account_login
rust_commands.purpose: Authenticate user via browser or SSO to access Expo services.

rust_commands.name: eas_branch_list
rust_commands.purpose: List available update branches for the current project.

rust_commands.name: eas_build
rust_commands.purpose: Initiate a cloud build for iOS or Android using project configuration and pinned CLI version.
